aries: Moon in Aries — quick, a little impulsive. Good for starting; watch hot decisions.
taurus: Moon in Taurus — slow and sensual. Time to enjoy, rest, and choose quality.
gemini: Moon in Gemini — fast mind, shifting moods. Good for conversation, hard to sustain focus.
cancer: Moon in Cancer — emotions near the surface. Good for family, home, familiar things.
leo: Moon in Leo — wants to be seen and appreciated. Good for creativity and sharing; watch ego drama.
virgo: Moon in Virgo — tidy, analytical mode. Good for detail, planning, cleaning up.
libra: Moon in Libra — seeks harmony and connection. Good for collaboration, hard to decide alone.
scorpio: Moon in Scorpio — intense, deep, a little heavy. Good for inner emotional work, honest with yourself.
sagittarius: Moon in Sagittarius — optimistic, wants to move. Good for new ideas, learning, exploration.
capricorn: Moon in Capricorn — disciplined, realistic. Good for focused work, hard to spiral anxious.
aquarius: Moon in Aquarius — cool, mental, a little distant. Good for big ideas, less for intimate closeness.
pisces: Moon in Pisces — sensitive, imaginative, empathic. Good for creativity and rest; watch absorbing others' moods.
